📖 How to use

  1. Type in the search box to filter commands.
  2. Click a command to copy it.
  3. Paste it in your terminal.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I search commands?

Yes — the search box filters by command name, flags, or description instantly.

How do I copy a command?

Click any command row to copy the full command to your clipboard.

Which topics are covered?

Files, text processing, processes, networking, disks, permissions, packages, and system info.

Which distros do the examples target?

Most examples work on Debian/Ubuntu and other Linux distros; apt examples target Debian-based systems.
